ui.about_lead: I-athlasi yesimo sezulu esebenza ungaxhunyiwe ku-inthanethi, ethola ukugxila kwangempela uma kudingeka. Okujwayelekile kwesimo sezulu somhlaba wonke kufakiwe ngaphakathi futhi kufundeka ngisho ungaxhunyiwe ku-inthanethi; izimo zamanje, izibikezelo, izexwayiso nezendlalelo ze-raster kulandwa kuphela uma ukucela.

ui.about_privacy: Izimpawu zakho zasekhaya nokhiye wakho we-OpenWeatherMap kugcinwa kulesi siphequluli kuphela futhi akulokothi kuthunyelwe indawo. Uhlelo luvula lungaxhunyiwe ku-inthanethi neze; luxhuma kuphela lapho udinga idatha yangempela, luthumela izixhumanisi ezidingekayo kuphela.
ui.about_foot: Weatherglass — yamahhala futhi eyakhelwe ukusebenza ungaxhunyiwe ku-inthanethi. Ukufundwa ngakunye kubonisa isikhathi saso; uma ungaxhunyiwe, okujwayelekile okufakiwe kuyasebenza.

ui.disc_body:
I-Weatherglass iyithuluzi lolwazi, hhayi isevisi yezokuphepha. Idatha yesimo sezulu, izibikezelo, uchungechunge lomlando nezexwayiso ezisemthethweni kulandwa emithonjeni yangaphandle (Open-Meteo, MET Norway, i-US National Weather Service, izinhlangano zikazwelonke zesimo sezulu, GDACS, ne-OpenWeatherMap uma ufaka ukhiye wakho). Kungase kubambezeleke, kungaphelele, kungabi yiqiniso, noma kungatholakali, futhi i-Weatherglass ingase iyifunde kabi noma yehluleke ukuyibonisa.

Ungasebenzisi lolu hlelo ukwenza izinqumo lapho impilo, impahla noma ukuphepha kokuhamba kusengozini — kuhlanganise nezivunguvungu, izikhukhula, izindiza, ukuhamba ngomkhumbi, ukukhwela izintaba noma umsebenzi wangaphandle. Njalo landela igunya lezulu lendawo yakho neziyalezo zokuvikeleka komphakathi; izexwayiso zabo zithatha isikhundla salokho okuboniswe lapha.

I-athlasi yesimo sezulu esebenza ungaxhunyiwe ku-inthanethi ibonisa izilinganiso zesikhathi eside (1991–2020) namarekhodi omlando. Ichaza izimo ezivamile, hhayi ukuthi isimo sezulu sizoba njani ngosuku oluthile.

Indawo isetshenziswa kuphela lapho uthepha ukuze uyisebenzise, kuphela ukuze kulandwe isimo sezulu saleyo ndawo, futhi ayilokothi igcinwe yithi. Izimpawu zakho zasekhaya nezilungiselelo kuhlala kule divayisi.

I-Weatherglass inikezwa ngamahhala, "njengoba injalo", ngaphandle kwesiqinisekiso saso nhlobo. Ngokugcwele okuvunyelwe umthetho, umbhali wayo akathatheli phezu kwakhe noma yikuphi ukulahlekelwa noma umonakalo ovela ekuyisebenziseni noma ekuncikeni okuqukethwe kwayo.

Ngokuthepha u-Ngiyaqonda futhi ngiyavuma uyaqinisekisa ukuthi ufunde lesi saziso. Sivela futhi ngemuva kokubuyekezwa ngakunye.
